# Cambridgeshire Live

> Cambridgeshire Live is a comprehensive regional news and lifestyle platform covering breaking news, local events, property markets, and community stories across Cambridge, Cambridgeshire, and surrounding areas.

The site serves as the primary news source for the Cambridgeshire region, featuring coverage of local news, traffic updates, entertainment events, property development, and human-interest stories. It includes specialized sections for food reviews (CamBites), regional town hubs, and a dating platform (LocalLoves) for local singles.

## Key Topics

- Cambridgeshire
- Cambridge
- Local News
- Property Market
- Traffic & Travel
- Health News

- Wisbech

- Regional Coverage

## Core News & Information
